19. Dependency inversion vs
injection

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Dependency inversion is a principle: high-level policy and low-level details depend on
abstractions. Dependency injection supplies dependencies externally; inversion of control is
broader.
සිංහJලෙන් DIP එක design principle එකක්. DI එJකන් dependency එක constructor එකට වJගේ පිටතින්
Jදනවා. IoC කියන්Jන් control එක framework එකකට Jහහෝ Jවන component එකකට පුවරීJම්
OrderService accepts an OrderRepository interface; a test injects an in-memory implementation.

SqlOrderRepository · OrderService OrderRepository interface · FakeOrderRepository · Implementations depend on the abstraction · Read the diagram: The client and concrete implementations depend on the shared abstraction. · Client එක සහ implementations Jපාදු abstraction එකට සම්බන්ධයි.

Expected result: Production and test implementations can be supplied without changing the
service.

Q: Does DI automatically ensure DIP?
A: No. Injecting a concrete class can still tightly couple high-level code to details.

Memory trick
DIP = depend on interface; DI = supply instance.
